Method of Attack: Shell injection vulnerability via subprocess.call with shell=True in Salt API
Authentication bypass flaw in Salt API via improper validation of eauth credentials and tokens
Permissions issue on cryptographic private key files allowing world-readable keys
Discoverer: KPC of Trend Micro Zero Day Initiative
Impacted Systems: Minions or Masters using create_ca, create_csr, create_self_signed_cert functions in TLS module
Attack Vector: Salt API via SSH client subprocess calls
Salt ssh via salt-api with improper eauth validation
TLS execution module functions creating keys with incorrect permissions
Indicators of Compromise: Shodan listing of 6,138 exposed SaltStack Master nodes
